cohort: 11134 infants from the nationally representative Growing-Up-in-Ireland (GUI) cohort
finding: Infants delivered by emergency CS had an increased risk of obesity at age three years, but there was insufficient evidence to support a causal relationship between elective CS and childhood obesity.
mod_finding: Infants delivered by emergency CS had an increased risk of obesity at age three years, while infants delivered by elective CS had an increased risk of obesity before adjusting for macrosomic children.
